test_title: PYST 30: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 18 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster DOES NOT belong to that group? (Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**Option (1): IKF**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/03345750a580c1b2a4f3bcba695ce82d871cf22b3a90f64d85b95a34d9e481ae.png] 

**Option (2): GID**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a678b99b791732a7b843defdf691f90ba195be0414034d57471699a03256f21.png] 

**Option (3): KMG**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/68187dd232b7c42082a6717de19630ed2d12da70e8073c8d947c2e5793f96e2b.png] 

**Option (4): MOJ**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/144284dd5d8d8bbf5ddce933b3995a0ee6f3cecf740d4f314a5fbab7622ae4f3.png] 

The letter-cluster that DOES NOT belong to the group is: **KMG.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option (3)"**
